note: 强提醒：打开应用时整页盖住主界面，用户点「知道了」才进主界面。内容只从这份文件读，改这里不用发版。字段：updated（本文件更新日期，YYYY-MM-DD）；items（数组，空数组 = 什么都不弹）。每条：id（换 id = 当成一条新提醒，必填且不重复）、level（info / warn / critical，决定那道颜色）、title（必填）、subtitle（可选，标题下面那行小字）、body（必填；行首标记决定排版：【…】小标题、- 条目、`…` 等宽块、其余段落）、actions（可选，[{label, url}]，url 留空 = 点了就关）、hard（默认 true，只能点按钮关掉，返回键不关）、every（默认 false，同一条只弹一次；true = 每次打开弹一次）、until（可选 YYYY-MM-DD，过完那天不再弹）。文本可以是纯字符串，也可以按语言分开写成 {"zh":"…","en":"…"}；拉不到、文件坏了、一条都不合格，一律不弹。

2026 年 11 月 12 日的异常提交已审计完毕。结论是：被注入的构建流程一次也没有执行，构建阶段注入的密钥没有被读取。v2.2.0 已用全新签名证书重新构建，可以恢复更新。
公告级别：已解除 · 最后更新 2026 年 11 月 12 日 18:20
【一、审计结论】
注入的构建流程由 v* 标签触发。两次注入各只存在约 48 秒即被一条 ci: restore 撤回，期间没有任何一次构建被它触发。
因此构建阶段注入的密钥（含签名证书、对象存储密钥）从未被读取，此前公告中「密钥已暴露」的判断不成立。
异常提交与诱饵 PR 现均已清除，仓库内无残留文件，工作流与注入前逐字节一致。
【二、这一版必须卸载重装】
出于谨慎，签名证书仍按「可能已泄露」处理，已整体更换并重新签发。
签名换了，安装包不能覆盖安装。请先导出备份，再卸载旧版，然后安装 v2.2.0。
新签名的 SHA-1 与 SHA-256 见下方，可自行核对。
【三、发布包与校验】
v2.2.0 及以后的安装包都由新证书签名。
官网与 GitHub Releases 上的 SHA-256 请以官方渠道为准。
新签名证书指纹
`SHA-1: BE:7C:EC:BA:1C:8F:9B:78:64:9A:2E:03:5C:D7:62:9E:BA:B1:4A:0C`
`SHA-256: 0F:2C:52:7A:9C:D6:6A:43:A8:71:F3:51:92:C7:5C:B7:5F:C1:B8:5B:6F:63:BA:45:8C:B5:A9:82:0A:2E:38:8A`
旧版本（v2.1.43 及更早）的签名已作废，日后出现旧签名的「新版本」一律视为伪造。
【四、官方不会做的事】
- 不会通过任何渠道索要密码、验证码。
- 不会要求远程控制你的设备。
【五、渠道】
- 网站：aprslocus.theez.top
- 反馈与举报：GitHub Issues
可信版本与校验值只以官方渠道为准，未经证实的安装包与补丁不要转发。

body.en:
The injected build workflow never ran and no key was read. v2.2.0 has been rebuilt with a new signing certificate, so updates can resume; because the certificate changed, uninstall the old version first.
The anomalous commits of 12 November 2026 have been audited. Conclusion: the injected build workflow never ran even once, and the keys injected at build time were never read. v2.2.0 has been rebuilt with a brand-new signing certificate and updates can resume.
Status: lifted · Last updated 12 November 2026, 18:20
【1. Audit conclusion】
The injected workflow was triggered by v* tags. Each of the two injections existed for about 48 seconds before a ci: restore commit reverted it, and no build was ever triggered by them.
So the keys injected at build time (signing certificate, object-storage keys) were never read, and the earlier statement that they had been exposed does not hold.
The anomalous commits and the decoy PR are removed; nothing is left in the repository and the workflows are byte-for-byte identical to before the injection.
【2. This version needs a clean install】
Out of caution the signing certificate is still treated as possibly leaked, so it has been replaced and reissued.
The certificate changed, so the package cannot be installed over the old one. Export a backup, uninstall the old version, then install v2.2.0.
The new fingerprints are below so you can check them yourself.
【3. Packages and verification】
v2.2.0 and later are signed with the new certificate.
For SHA-256, trust the official site and GitHub Releases only.
New signing certificate
`SHA-1: BE:7C:EC:BA:1C:8F:9B:78:64:9A:2E:03:5C:D7:62:9E:BA:B1:4A:0C`
`SHA-256: 0F:2C:52:7A:9C:D6:6A:43:A8:71:F3:51:92:C7:5C:B7:5F:C1:B8:5B:6F:63:BA:45:8C:B5:A9:82:0A:2E:38:8A`
Packages signed with the old certificate (v2.1.43 and earlier) are void; a new version carrying the old signature is a forgery.
【4. What the project will never do】
- Ask for your password or verification code through any channel.
- Ask for remote control of your device.
【5. Channels】
- Website: aprslocus.theez.top
- Feedback and reports: GitHub Issues
Trust only the official channels for packages and checksums, and do not forward unverified packages or patches.
